nodes.label: Slide geometry (1920x1080, 96px safe, 96px footer)
nodes.rationale: Fixed 16:9 1920x1080 frame with a 96px (5%) safe margin on all sides and a 96px footer zone at the bottom. Both the margin and the footer are 5% of the frame, expressed as sp-7, so slide geometry lands on the same 8px grid as component spacing. Drawn with inset-inline so it holds under RTL.
